card.name: Words just before 'at all' or 'any'
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected 'at all', 'at any', or similar minimiser phrase, often after a negation, a condition, or a verb like hesitate or pause. It fires on 'at', 'without', 'one' or the verb itself.

modes.label: 'at' before all/any
modes.description: The word 'at' after a verb or negated clause, where 'all' or 'any stage' comes next.

modes.label: Hesitate or pause verbs
modes.description: Verbs like hesitated or paused in conditions, where a minimiser such as 'at all' could follow.
modes.example: If he hes<<itated>> or if he paused, then Ganap

modes.label: Negated amount phrases
modes.description: Words like 'without' or 'one' in phrases meaning not even a little.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word 'all' (as in 'at all') and away from 'at least' type words.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up the phrase 'at all' or 'not even a bit'.
